walkability_intro: Serro at The Heights is positioned within a low-density, family-oriented master community. The pedestrian experience is deliberately designed around wellness rather than urban convenience.

walkability.title: Internal Walkability
walkability.content: The community features extensive landscaped walking paths, jogging tracks, and pedestrian-friendly street design connecting residential clusters to amenity nodes (wellness lake, parks, clubhouse).

walkability.title: External Walkability
walkability.content: A metro station is not within walking distance. The nearest existing stations are approximately 15 - 20 minutes by vehicle.

walkability.title: Daily Convenience
walkability.content: Grocery stores and retail outlets are planned within the community retail zone but will not be operational until 2027 - 2029. Early residents will require vehicular access to supermarkets in Dubai South or Expo City.

walkability_note: Car-dependent community. This is by design - The Heights prioritises wellness space over urban density. Best suited to families with private transport.
drive_source_note: Source: Google Maps estimates validated against RTA infrastructure updates.

infrastructure_developments.title: RTA Al Qudra Road Development
bullets: The RTA has completed a 600-metre, four-lane bridge at the intersection of Al Qudra Road and the link road to Arabian Ranches / Dubai Studio City, increasing capacity by 191% (6,600 to 19,200 vehicles per hour) and reducing waiting time by 55%.
A second bridge opening on 15 Feb 2026 at Al Qudra Road & Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street provides four lanes in each direction, reducing wait times by 85% (393s to 60s).
infrastructure_developments.relevance: These upgrades improve connectivity between the southern growth corridor and central Dubai. The enhanced Al Qudra Road corridor benefits communities positioned similarly to The Heights in terms of Dubai South access.

infrastructure_developments.title: Dubai Metro Blue Line
bullets: The 30-kilometre Blue Line extension will connect Dubai Creek Harbour and Festival City directly to Dubai South and Expo City, with 14 new stations.
While completion is post-2030, the awarded contract signals long-term government commitment to transit-oriented development in the southern corridor.

infrastructure_developments.title: Al Maktoum International Airport
bullets: AED 128 billion (USD 34 - 35B) investment approved for new terminal infrastructure, positioning DWC as the world's largest airport with 260 million passenger capacity.
Major passenger operations will progressively shift from DXB to Al Maktoum, concentrating aviation-driven employment and housing demand in Dubai South.

neighbourhood_intro: The Heights is positioned as an emerging, wellness-focused residential district. Unlike the buzzing energy of Dubai Marina or the urban intensity of Downtown, The Heights offers:

neighbourhood_vibe.title: Low-density living
neighbourhood_vibe.content: 25% green space allocation, villa-only product mix.

neighbourhood_vibe.title: Wellness orientation
neighbourhood_vibe.content: Dedicated wellness lake, meditation gardens, extensive trail networks.

neighbourhood_vibe.title: Family focus
neighbourhood_vibe.content: School catchments, children's play areas, community safety.

neighbourhood_vibe.title: Construction phase
neighbourhood_vibe.content: 2026 - 2030 will see active development; early residents should expect a live building site environment for 12 - 24 months post-first handovers.

map_description: Map showing Serro at The Heights positioned within The Heights Country Club & Wellness master community, located near the intersection of Expo Road and Al Yalayis Street (E77). The community sits approximately 8 kilometres north of Al Maktoum International Airport, 12 kilometres east of Expo City Dubai, and 25 kilometres southwest of Downtown Dubai. Emirates Road (E611) provides the primary north - south arterial connection, with the recently upgraded Al Qudra Road corridor improving east - west connectivity to Arabian Ranches and Studio City.
